summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Just Ayurveda e-commerce website with new multi-page structure, admin panel, and cart functionality. Backend APIs are fully functional with admin authentication and CRUD operations working correctly. Frontend UI works well with proper age gate behavior, multi-page routing, cart system, checkout flow, and admin panel functionality.

ui_bugs.issue: Minor timeout issues when clicking FAQ accordion items due to overlay interception
Occasional overlay interception preventing search button clicks

passed_tests: Backend: All 22 API tests passed (products, search, sort, filter, admin auth, CRUD operations)
Age gate appears on public pages but NOT on /admin/* routes (correct behavior)
Homepage loads with hero, trust badges, featured products, benefits, and CTA section
Navigation works between all pages: /, /products, /about, /faq, /contact
Products page shows all 6 products with working filter/sort controls
Individual product pages load correctly for all slugs: vitalmax-pro-capsules, shilajit-resin-ultra, ashwagandha-gold-extract, kesar-vigor-oil, endurance-elixir-tonic
Product detail pages have working breadcrumb, image, description, tabs, FAQ, reviews
Buy Now button adds product to cart and navigates to /checkout
Cart badge count updates in navbar when item is added
Checkout page shows order summary with quantity controls
Checkout page has working form fields: name, email, phone, address
Admin login page at /admin/login renders without age gate blocking
Admin login with admin@justayurveda.in / admin123 succeeds and redirects to dashboard
Admin dashboard shows products table, stats cards, and orders tab
Admin can add a new product via dialog form
Admin can edit existing products
Admin CRUD operations work correctly
About page shows brand story content
FAQ page shows 33 accordion items
Contact page shows WhatsApp CTA and store details
WhatsApp floating button visible on public pages only
Search from navbar navigates to /products?search=query with results
Mobile menu functionality works correctly
Order creation returns expected error about Razorpay config (placeholder keys)

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (minor overlay interaction issues with FAQ and search)
